title: Tag tables with I/O, memory tags and user constants

vci_SimaticSD.Tags_IO: Tags_IO supports the formats SimaticML. (vci_sync INVALID_ARGUMENT for Tags_IO; tag tables have no SimaticSD format)
vci_SimaticSD.Tags_Memory: Tags_IO supports the formats SimaticML. (vci_sync INVALID_ARGUMENT for Tags_IO; tag tables have no SimaticSD format)

notes: Tag tables produce no compile messages. ServiceWord is not accessible from HMI/OPC UA (ExternalAccessible false). The de-DE comments are only in the SimaticML file (plc_get_tag_table returns the editing language). No compile message names this case's objects; the PLC compiles that include them ended with 0 errors. Added 2026-10-24 by PLC Studio (verification session 5): simaticml/ holds the same two tables exported through Openness (PlcTagTable.Export, ExportOptions WithDefaults), which writes the attributes at their default value that VCI leaves out.
